doc: Defaults for GreyboxZone (M3-ARC-01; docs/kb/tech/chapter_flow.md): a zone layout file may override any of these per zone. Sizes in metres, angles in degrees, colours as #rrggbb.

encounters._note: M2-FP-28: FieldEncounters defaults a layout's encounters block may override. grace_m: metres walked after a random battle before the meter runs again. max_step_m: a frame's move longer than this is a placement, never walking.
